answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable stake that grows with the number of identities sharing its funding source, so splitting capital across fakes never gets cheaper. Stake is escrowed for 30 days and slashed if an identity's votes correlate with its siblings' beyond a threshold. Ten fakes cost ten stakes plus slashing risk. A honest agent may wander in cheaply, but a farm faces a canyon of capital, and any plume of coordinated votes exposes it.
